title: Settings
intro: Gateway key, extras, and defaults for the {workspaceName} desk. Other workspaces keep their own keys and setup. Paste your {gatewayName} API key from {gatewayHost} to use chat and job modes on this desk.
gatewayHelp: Paste your gateway API key for this desk. It never comes back after save.
endpointHint: HTTPS only. Plain http:// works for a local model server on 127.0.0.1.
saved: Saved. Keys stay on this desk.
privacy: Prompts leave this machine only over HTTPS to the saved endpoint. {productName} does not log prompts. Keys and threads are encrypted on disk. {gatewayName} retention is the gateway's policy.
languageHelp: Applies after you restart DPSBuddy. Chat and job modes follow this language.
